auth_methods.quote: Your app sends the token in the `X-Shopify-Access-Token` header on every GraphQL Admin API request.

access.quote: The credentials that identify your app, issued when you create it. The client ID is public.

api_surface.breadth.quote: Shopify apps call the [GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql) to read and write store data on behalf of merchants.

mcp.exists.quote: Shopify AI Toolkit connects your AI coding tools to Shopify's developer docs, API schemas, and CLI store management

buildability.main_blocker.quote: Fields that return a customer's personal data need a separate approval if your app is public.

buildability.verdict.quote: Shopify grants some access scopes to individual apps rather than to every app that declares them.
